# descope_sns_connector (Resource)

Manages a AWS SNS connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Send text messages through Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `region` (String) The AWS region the SNS service is configured in.

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) The AWS access key ID. Required when the authentication type is 'credentials'.
- `auth_type` (String) How to authenticate with AWS: using static credentials or by assuming an IAM role.
- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `endpoint` (String) A custom endpoint for the SNS API. Leave empty to use the default AWS endpoint.
- `entity_id` (String) The entity ID used for regulatory registration, where required.
- `external_id` (String) The external ID used when assuming the IAM role. Required when the authentication type is 'assumeRole'.
- `origination_number` (String) The phone number that text messages are sent from.
- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role to assume. Required when the authentication type is 'assumeRole'.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) The AWS secret access key. Required when the authentication type is 'credentials'.
- `sender_id` (String) The sender ID shown as the origin of the text messages, where supported.
- `template_id` (String) The template ID used for regulatory registration, where required.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
